violations.description: General employee practices. — --Food employee observed drinking/using open beverage container outside of designated area. Store personal beverages away from food service items to protect from potential contamination.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Spray bottle sanitizer at dough sheeting station in BOH prep area not maintained at proper concentrations. Too strong.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. BOH prep kitchen stove/oven not located under hood.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Microwaves/reach in coolers/slicer/stove have buildup of food debris and need cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. BOH kitchen/prep area counters/shelving/storage racks have dust/debris build up and need cleaning. Walk in cooler wire rack shelving has build up of food debris and need cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. FOH hood/filters have a build up of dust/grease and need cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walls in dough prep room have build up of dust/cob webs/flour and need cleaning. Walls around FOH pizza prep area have dust/cobwebs and need cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Ceiling in BOH prep kitchen has damage from recent roof leak and needs repair. Floor tiles near dish machine damaged and need replacing.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. FOH upright cooler and BOH 2 door upright cooler not maintained below 41 degrees F.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Detail cleaning needed to FOH cabinets.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors need cleaning under equipment and along wall junctures.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Damaged floor tiles around dish machine in BOH kitchen.
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
